comparison.objective: Hang a cable between two hooks with a specified sag; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable routing, hooking and tension/sag control versus rigid fine-tool insertion, torque and iterative rotary tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Cable must remain on both hooks with sag in the required range and be released; candidate requires two compliant impact cycles.
comparison.reason: Both involve tuning a measured physical state, but cable geometry and damping response are different tested abilities.
